boxes.title: Clear session cache?  (16px)
boxes.words: Clears this session from RAM: input, reply, thread, transparency, branches, attachments, timers. Does not change settings.json, Ollama, or image files on disk.  (12px)

boxes.words: This resets bonsAI like a fresh install: settings, permissions, chats, notes, cache and logs are deleted. If AI ran on this Deck, its downloaded models and the Ollama install bonsAI set up go too. Desktop logs stay.  (12px, 37 words)
